snippet.title: Joymaker Announcement Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Joymaker is an indie horror game set in a toy factory. Play as a mysterious figure with strange tasks scrawled in his journal, and unravel the secrets of this terrible place and the mind of a man who has lost everything. 

Joymaker is scheduled to release this October on Steam.
